gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement p4 prints one row 'Operating transfers in (out)': General (52,000), Street 85,577, Debt Service (168,668), Total (135,091). The JSON statement records the netted Total: transfers_in null, transfers_out 135,091. detail[] records the fund rows gross from the budget schedules: General Fund Transfers Out (52,000) (p15), Debt Service Fund Transfers Out (168,668) (p21), Street Fund Transfers In 85,577 (p17). 52,000 + 168,668 = 220,668 (schedule) vs 135,091 (statement): 220,668 - 85,577 = 135,091. Statement Total column nets the transfers; detail is correct and complete (Sale of assets 119,796, Street, p4/p17, is also in detail). No change.

No schedule lines for the proprietary funds. Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Fund Types (p8) prints Water / Sewer / Garbage columns. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 935,829 + interest revenue 749. Added per column: Water 276,021 + 20,627 + 1,584 = 298,232 + interest 573 = 298,805; Sewer 417,082 + 843 + 1,462 = 419,387 + interest 176 = 419,563; Garbage 198,994 + 19,216 = 218,210. 298,805 + 419,563 + 218,210 = 936,578 = statement total. 0 + 936,578 = 936,578, gap 0.
